search_papers_bulk.description: Pull an entire filtered set of papers, 1,000 at a time. Unlike relevance search this ranks nothing; it returns everything that matches, in the order you sort by, with a continuation token to fetch the next batch. The text query is optional and understands boolean operators: '+' for AND, '|' for OR, '-' to exclude, quotes for a phrase, '*' for a prefix and '~N' for fuzziness. Give it at least a query or one filter.
